fix_subject: Keep barred filters on top of a projection when another filter stays there
pr_title: protects against a particular case wherein the user predicate can jump

labels.summary: Barrier-protected filters (from secure views) were pushed through a projection even when another filter had to stay on top of or below it, so they could be evaluated before the filter that should guard them; the fix holds barrier filters back in that case.

not_strict_because: no failing fix-added case (fix-modified file only)
